svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Mendel crossed two pea plants that were both heterozygous for flower colour (Pp \u00d7 Pp)."], [1, "Meiosis: each parent makes gametes carrying P or p, in equal numbers."], [3.5, "Fertilisation is random: the Punnett square shows every combination."], [8, "Offspring genotypes: 1 PP : 2 Pp : 1 pp."], [10.5, "Phenotypes: 3 purple : 1 white. Purple is dominant, so PP and Pp look the same."]]
svg.title: Monohybrid cross
svg.desc: A Punnett square for Pp crossed with Pp in pea plants: gametes P and p, offspring PP, Pp, Pp and pp, with a 3 purple to 1 white ratio.
svg.text: Pea flower colour. P = purple (dominant), p = white (recessive).

g.data-info: Both are heterozygous (Pp): purple flowers, because purple (P) is dominant over white (p).
Meiosis separates the two alleles: each gamete carries only one allele, P or p, with equal probability.
Each box shows one possible combination at fertilisation. Each box has a probability of 1/4.
Genotypes 1 PP : 2 Pp : 1 pp. Phenotypes 3 purple : 1 white. These are probabilities, not exact counts.
